name: Painting / Coating
structure_example: Process > Step > Work element, e.g. Paint Line > Spray Booth > Environment (humidity/temperature) / Method (spray parameters) / Material (paint batch)
function_example: Applies a uniform, defect-free coating of specified film thickness that meets color and gloss requirements

failure_chains_starter.fe: Visible paint defect on a customer-facing surface, perceived as poor quality
failure_chains_starter.fc: Booth humidity outside the qualified spray window
failure_chains_starter.pc: Booth humidity control system with alarm on excursion
failure_chains_starter.dc: 100% visual inspection under standard lighting/angle + periodic gloss-meter audit

failure_chains_starter.fe: Coated part fails salt-spray corrosion testing, risking warranty claims
failure_chains_starter.fc: Substrate surface contamination not fully removed before coating
failure_chains_starter.pc: Pretreatment bath chemistry SPC + tank concentration monitoring
failure_chains_starter.dc: Cross-hatch adhesion test per sampling frequency + salt-spray audit testing

special_characteristics_guidance: Film thickness and cure temperature/time on corrosion-critical or customer-visible surfaces are the most common SC candidates in this domain.
